title: Dark Arisen — Higgsfield CLI O3DE Production Asset Catalog

hero_character.generateCommand: higgsfield generate create multi_image_to_3d --image <FRONT> --image <SIDE> --image <BACK> --should_texture true --enable_pbr true --should_remesh true --topology quad --enable_rigging true --pose_mode a-pose --rigging_height_meters <HEIGHT_M> --wait --json
hero_character.post: resolve animation_action_id with `higgsfield preset list animation-action --query <ACTION> --json`; use 3d_rigging only where the generated skeleton/mesh needs a separate animation pass

creature.generateCommand: higgsfield generate create multi_image_to_3d --image <FRONT> --image <SIDE> --image <BACK> --should_texture true --enable_pbr true --should_remesh true --topology quad --wait --json

ship.generateCommand: higgsfield generate create multi_image_to_3d --image <PORT> --image <STARBOARD> --image <BOW> --image <STERN> --should_texture true --enable_pbr true --should_remesh true --topology quad --target_polycount 180000 --wait --json

environment_kit.generateCommand: higgsfield generate create tripo_3d --prompt <PROMPT> --negative_prompt <NEGATIVE> --face_limit 120000 --geometry_quality detailed --pbr true --texture true --texture_quality detailed --wait --json
environment_kit.rule: Generate modular kit pieces, not an entire baked gameplay level. Collision remains authored in O3DE.

prop.generateCommand: higgsfield generate create tripo_3d --prompt <PROMPT> --negative_prompt <NEGATIVE> --face_limit 45000 --geometry_quality detailed --pbr true --texture true --texture_quality detailed --wait --json

o3deIngest.provenance: Importer writes <assetId>.provenance.json; final O3DE Asset Processor + visual/material/collision review remains mandatory.

canonGuards: Real Ethan Harlow is alive after rescue, friendly, non-hostile and must never be authored as a boss.
Chapter 9 uses a distinct Dream / Memory Ethan representation.
Collision and walkability remain authored/verified in O3DE; visual AI meshes do not replace physics contracts.
No AI-generated asset may silently replace authored story geometry without scale and anchor validation.

greyboxCoverage.rationale: Structural blockouts, collision sources, ocean simulation tiles and logic markers are engine-authored contracts, not generative art targets.
